newsitem.title: INDIA: Unilever's Indian subsidiaries may merge.
newsitem.headline: Unilever's Indian subsidiaries may merge.

text.p: Cosmetics firm Pond's India Ltd may merge with Hindustan Lever Ltd (HLL), newspapers reported on Saturday.
Both the firms are subsidiaries of Anglo-Dutch conglomerate Unilever Plc.
"There's considerable overlap in product portfolio and exports between HLL and Pond's," the Economic Times quoted K.B. Dadiseth, chairman of Pond's and HLL, as saying.
He said the firms share the same network for selling and distribution and there were synergies in many areas.

"If it calls for strategic and commercial business sense, then it is necessary to take the right decision," Dadiseth told Pond's shareholders in Madras on Friday, the paper said, adding: "It will be in the best interests of the shareholders.
The firms could not be immediately reached for comment.
Another Unilever subsidiary Brooke Bond Lipton India Ltd had merged with HLL effective January 1, 1996.
